title: Composition of execution contracts
statement: Let $C_1$ be a contract from entry state $e_1$ to the singleton exit state $e_2$, and let $C_2$ be a contract from $e_2$ to a set $X$ of states. Suppose a map sends each data value for $C_1$ to a data value for $C_2$, and every endpoint of $C_1$ satisfying its precondition satisfies the corresponding precondition of $C_2$. Also suppose that before the end of $C_1$, the run's state is outside $X$. The composed contract uses the precondition of $C_1$, runs for the sum of the two assigned times, ends at the endpoint assigned by $C_2$, and bounds each work-tape head between the minimum of the two lower bounds and the maximum of the two upper bounds.
